# Keen Agent protocol fixtures

`ueu-vectors.json` is generated by the keen-agent repository's
`internal/ueu` tests (`UPDATE_VECTORS=1 go test ./internal/ueu -run
TestVectors`). It pins the exact bytes of a canonical UEU envelope, its
evidence hash, a signed batch manifest, a subject pseudonym and a signed
heartbeat request, all from a fixed synthetic key. Keen's verifier must
reproduce every value, so the agent and Keen cannot drift apart silently.
Replace the file only together with a deliberate protocol change in both
repositories. It contains no real credentials.
